notes:
{抑止|よくし} refers to the prevention of actions through deterrence or restraint, commonly used in security, military, and policy contexts.

WRITING:
- {抑|よく} (suppress, restrain)
- {止|し} (stop)

USAGE:
- {抑止|よくし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to deter, to restrain - suru verb)
- ⟦{抑止力|よくしりょく}→抑止力：15454_yokushiryoku⟧ (deterrent power/force)
- {抑止|よくし}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ (deterrent effect)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧{抑止|よくし} (crime deterrence)
- {核|かく}{抑止|よくし} (nuclear deterrence)
- ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧{抑止|よくし} (war deterrence)
- ⟦{抑止力|よくしりょく}→抑止力：15454_yokushiryoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to function as a deterrent)

REGISTER:
- Formal/technical term
- Common in news, academic, and policy discussions
- Related to defense and security policy discussions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抑制|よくせい}→抑制：05635_yokusei⟧ focuses more on control/restraint of something already in progress
- {抑止|よくし} focuses on preventing something from starting
